capabilities: Render MEI, MusicXML, ABC, PAE, Humdrum, CMME, GABC and Volpiano scores to SVG from files, URLs, or code blocks
Edit notation code in a side panel linked bidirectionally with the rendered SVG
Play back scores with live note highlighting
Convert supported notation formats to MEI via the command palette or side panel
Sketch notation with a Plaine & Easie editor and insert it as a code block
extras: The author discloses the plugin was largely AI-assisted ('vibecoded') and carries residual risk; playback requires internet access to download SoundFonts and does not work offline; GABC playback is disabled; mobile support omits download and external-editor buttons.
motivation: The author says the plugin bridges gaps in their own workflow of working with written music.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display, edit, or play back musical scores inside notes.

relations.evidence: uses Verovio – an open-source library for engraving Music Encoding Initiative (MEI) music scores
the side panel editing functions were taken from the mei-friend editor
many functions for quick and dirty PAE insertion were adapted from this editor
lz-midi may download instrument SoundFont files

summary: Renders MEI, MusicXML, ABC, PAE, Humdrum, GABC and Volpiano notation as SVG in notes, with side-panel editing and audio playback.
